activity.notes: Representative chronological point at c.1125 BCE for Jael within the same Deborah-Barak/Sisera conflict tradition. This is not a lifespan, residence interval, or claim of exact event dating. Because Jael's remembered act belongs to the Sisera episode, ATLAS places her at the same uncertain representative point instead of rendering the former 1200-1100 BCE broad era window as a 100-year personal activity rail.

sources.title: Eric H. Cline, The Battles of Armageddon: Megiddo and the Jezreel Valley from the Bronze Age to the Nuclear Age
sources.citation_text: Cline's historical synthesis treats the Deborah-Barak-Sisera episode under the chronological heading 1125 BCE. Jael belongs to that same Sisera episode in Judges 4–5; ATLAS uses 1125 only as an uncertain representative anchor.
